executiveSummary: This period saw multiple high-impact law-enforcement and national-security developments alongside enterprise-scale financial fraud enabled by synthetic media. Authorities in the U.S. and Europe seized domains distributing nude digital forgeries of women, and New York prosecutors dismantled 12 deepfake pornography sites tied to more than 1,200 victims, signaling more assertive disruption of abusive deepfake infrastructure. View Article Supporting Report State-linked misuse of AI remained prominent: researchers reported Russia-linked operators using an AI assistant against more than 20 sensitive government and defense targets, while Western agencies warned that Iranian operators used deceptive files, including fake MRI results, to compromise dissidents and journalists. View Article Supporting Report Operational fraud campaigns advanced on two fronts: a phishing-as-a-service kit used AI voice agents to socially engineer iPhone passcodes from recent theft victims, and more than one million AI-tailored invoice impersonation emails pursued $50,000-scale payments. Source Source Regulatory and platform-governance actions also shifted: EU AI Act transparency obligations require deepfake labeling and machine-readable marks, and Meta was ordered to remove widely viewed political deepfakes, highlighting moderation gaps. Source Source Primary synthetic-media modalities this cycle included cloned voice in vishing and virtual-kidnapping scams, manipulated video for harassment and political disinformation, and document-based lures in espionage. Supporting Report Defensive research cautioned that provenance watermarks can create detector "shortcuts" and that fraud call detectors degrade under realistic near-domain scenarios-important caveats for enterprise validation and law-enforcement forensics. Supporting Report Supporting Report Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening, with concurrent expansion of AI-enabled fraud, persistent national-security misuse, and large-scale abusive deepfake operations despite new enforcement activity.
